findings.note: internal/findings/findings.go:325 calls supersedesFreshness for every existing record on every run, unconditionally (not gated by previousRuns/resetRuns like the adjacent 'fixed' transition at line 152). Verified this is intentional per spec §6.5/§11.3 (freshness rows are re-evaluated by any newer run of matching engine, not tied to run-chain lineage) and covered by TestFreshEvidenceSupersedesAStaleRowNeverFixesIt; noting only because the asymmetry with the neighboring fixed-transition guard is easy to misread as a bug on a quick pass.
